title: The Necklace
summary: A woman borrows a beautiful necklace for one party, loses it, and spends ten years paying for the mistake.

source.author: Guy de Maupassant
source.note: Retold from the plot in new B2 English by Lexkite; no sentences copied from any translation.

license: Adaptation CC BY 4.0 Lexkite; original story in the public domain

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: an elegant woman in a long evening dress at a grand ball, a sparkling necklace at her throat, warm lights, no text

chapters.title: A Night to Remember
sentences: Mathilde was a pretty young woman who felt that she had been born into the wrong life.
Her husband worked as a minor clerk, and they lived in a modest apartment that she found depressing.
She dreamed constantly of luxury, of servants, silk dresses, and grand dinners.
One evening her husband came home looking proud and handed her an invitation to a ministry ball.
To his disappointment, she burst into tears instead of thanking him.
She had nothing suitable to wear, she complained, and she refused to go looking poor.
He gave her the four hundred francs he had saved for a hunting trip so that she could buy a dress.
Still she was not satisfied, because she owned no jewellery to wear with it.
Her husband suggested that she borrow something from her wealthy friend, Madame Forestier.
Her friend generously opened a box and let her choose, and Mathilde picked a magnificent diamond necklace.
At the ball she was the most admired woman in the room, and she danced happily until four in the morning.

quiz.q: Why did Mathilde cry when she received the invitation?
options: She had nothing suitable to wear.
She was afraid of her husband.
quiz.explain: She said she had no dress and would look poor.

quiz.q: Where did the money for her dress come from?
quiz.explain: Her husband gave her the money he had saved for a hunting trip.

quiz.q: What did she borrow from Madame Forestier?
quiz.explain: She chose a magnificent diamond necklace.

chapters.title: The Price of Pride
sentences: When they reached home, Mathilde took one last look at herself in the mirror and froze.
The necklace was no longer around her neck.
They searched the coat, the street, and the carriage, but they found nothing.
A week later they gave up hope, and her husband decided that they must replace it.
In a jeweller's shop they found a similar necklace that cost thirty-six thousand francs.
He used his inheritance and borrowed the rest at terrible rates of interest.
Madame Forestier received the new necklace and did not notice anything unusual.
For ten years the couple worked extremely hard to pay off their debt.
They dismissed the maid, moved to a cheaper attic, and Mathilde scrubbed floors with rough, red hands.
One Sunday she met Madame Forestier by chance and decided to tell her the whole truth.
Her friend was shocked and replied that the original necklace had been only imitation, worth about five hundred francs.

quiz.q: What did the couple discover after the ball?
options: The necklace was stolen by a friend.
quiz.explain: Mathilde noticed that the necklace was missing from her neck.

quiz.q: How did they pay for the replacement?
options: They used an inheritance and took out loans.
quiz.explain: He used his inheritance and borrowed the rest.

options: The old necklace was a cheap imitation.
The necklace was found in the street.
quiz.explain: Her friend said the original was only an imitation worth little.
